## Download References
```{bash, eval = FALSE}
#Z. pseudorouxii
wget -nc -P data/Z_pseudo https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/026/365/GCF_000026365.1_ASM2636v1/GCF_000026365.1_ASM2636v1_genomic.fna.gz

wget -nc -P data/Z_pseudo https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/026/365/GCF_000026365.1_ASM2636v1/GCF_000026365.1_ASM2636v1_protein.faa.gz

wget -nc -P data/Z_pseudo https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/026/365/GCF_000026365.1_ASM2636v1/GCF_000026365.1_ASM2636v1_rna.fna.gz


#T. delbrueckii
wget -nc -P data/T_del https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/243/375/GCF_000243375.1_ASM24337v1/GCF_000243375.1_ASM24337v1_genomic.fna.gz

wget -nc -P data/T_del https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/243/375/GCF_000243375.1_ASM24337v1/GCF_000243375.1_ASM24337v1_protein.faa.gz

wget -nc -P data/T_del https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/243/375/GCF_000243375.1_ASM24337v1/GCF_000243375.1_ASM24337v1_rna.fna.gz


#L. thermotolerans
wget -nc -P data/L_thermo https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/142/805/GCF_000142805.1_ASM14280v1/GCF_000142805.1_ASM14280v1_genomic.fna.gz

wget -nc -P data/L_thermo https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/142/805/GCF_000142805.1_ASM14280v1/GCF_000142805.1_ASM14280v1_protein.faa.gz

wget -nc -P data/L_thermo https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/142/805/GCF_000142805.1_ASM14280v1/GCF_000142805.1_ASM14280v1_rna.fna.gz
```

## QC on Reads
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda activate sequali-env
sequali --outdir outputs/Z_pseudo/sequali data/Z_pseudo/zygosaccharomycesPseudorouxii.fastq

sequali --outdir outputs/L_thermo/sequali data/L_thermo/lachanceaThermotolerans.fastq

sequali --outdir outputs/T_del/sequali data/T_del/torulasporaDelbrueckii.fastq
```

## Filtering
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
filtlong data/Z_pseudo/zygosaccharomycesPseudorouxii.fastq --min_length 500 --min_mean_q 90 > outputs/Z_pseudo/Z_pseudo_filt.fastq

filtlong data/L_thermo/lachanceaThermotolerans.fastq --min_length 500 --min_mean_q 90 > outputs/L_thermo/L_thermo_filt.fastq

filtlong data/T_del/torulasporaDelbrueckii.fastq --min_length 500 --min_mean_q 90 > outputs/T_del/T_del_filt.fastq
```

## QC Post-Filtering
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
sequali --outdir outputs/Z_pseudo/sequali outputs/Z_pseudo/Z_pseudo_filt.fastq

sequali --outdir outputs/L_thermo/sequali outputs/L_thermo/L_thermo_filt.fastq

sequali --outdir outputs/T_del/sequali outputs/T_del/T_del_filt.fastq
conda deactivate
```

## Assembly
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda activate flye-env
flye --nano-raw outputs/Z_pseudo/Z_pseudo_filt.fastq --out-dir outputs/Z_pseudo/flye --threads 8 --genome-size 10m

flye --nano-raw outputs/L_thermo/L_thermo_filt.fastq --out-dir outputs/L_thermo/flye --threads 8 --genome-size 10m

flye --nano-raw outputs/T_del/T_del_filt.fastq --out-dir outputs/T_del/flye --threads 8 --genome-size 9m
conda deactivate
```

## Assembly Statistics
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(stringr)
Z_log <- readLines("outputs/Z_pseudo/flye/flye.log")
start <- grep("Assembly statistics:", Z_log)
Z <- Z_log[(start+2):(start+7)]
Z <- str_replace_all(Z, "\t", "")
Z <- strsplit(Z, ":")
Z_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, Z))
print("Z. pseudorouxii Assembly Stats")
print(Z_df)

cat("\n")
L_log <- readLines("outputs/L_thermo/flye/flye.log")
start <- grep("Assembly statistics:", L_log)
L <- L_log[(start+2):(start+7)]
L <- str_replace_all(L, "\t", "")
L <- strsplit(L, ":")
L_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, L))
print("L. thermotolerans Assembly Stats")
print(L_df)

cat("\n")
T_log <- readLines("outputs/T_del/flye/flye.log")
start <- grep("Assembly statistics:", T_log)
Td <- T_log[(start+2):(start+7)]
Td <- str_replace_all(Td, "\t", "")
Td <- strsplit(Td, ":")
T_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, Td))
print("T. delbrueckii Assembly Stats")
print(T_df)
```
